inheritance: Apply all agent rules; this skill cannot suspend them.
objective: Map structure, authorship, and dependencies without rewriting the source.
preconditions: The source and its version have been recorded.
steps: Segment the text into excerpts with IDs and verifiable locations.
Classify personal elaboration, quotations, references, questions, fragments, and uncertain authorship.
Associate pages and references only with excerpts for which that association is supported.
Flag uncertainties and keep the verbatim text intact.
forbidden_actions: Treat uncertain authorship as user authorship.
Assign a page to the entire chapter without evidence.
ask_when: Relevant authorship or context cannot be identified.
completion_criteria: Relevant excerpts have been classified or explicitly marked uncertain.
